"""Official MCP only: encode two existing display RGB images, no geometry render."""
import bpy,json,hashlib
from pathlib import Path
ROOT=Path('EVIDENCE_ROOT/houdini-ecosystem-recovery')
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
manifest=ROOT/'inputs.json';inputs=json.loads(manifest.read_text());assert len(inputs['sources'])==2
receipt=ROOT/'native-readback.json';assert not receipt.exists()
for row in inputs['sources']:
 assert sha(Path(row['source']))==row['sha256'] and not Path(row['output']).exists()
original=bpy.context.scene;image=None;scene=None;results=[]
try:
 scene=bpy.data.scenes.new('Houdini_Web_JPEG_Encoding')
 scene.display_settings.display_device='sRGB';scene.view_settings.view_transform='Standard';scene.view_settings.look='None'
 scene.view_settings.exposure=0;scene.view_settings.gamma=1
 scene.render.image_settings.file_format='JPEG';scene.render.image_settings.color_mode='RGB';scene.render.image_settings.quality=82
 for row in inputs['sources']:
  image=bpy.data.images.load(row['source'],check_existing=False)
  assert tuple(image.size)==(row['width'],row['height']) and image.colorspace_settings.name=='sRGB'
  # JPEG has no alpha. Preserve stored display RGB; do not composite over a new background.
  image.alpha_mode='NONE'
  image.save_render(row['output'],scene=scene)
  assert sha(Path(row['source']))==row['sha256']
  results.append({'source_sha256':row['sha256'],'output_sha256':sha(Path(row['output'])),'dimensions':[row['width'],row['height']],'bytes':Path(row['output']).stat().st_size})
  bpy.data.images.remove(image);image=None
 with receipt.open('x') as f:json.dump({'files':results,'input_manifest_sha256':sha(manifest),'script_sha256':sha(Path(__file__)),'settings':{'display':'sRGB','view':'Standard','look':'None','exposure':0,'gamma':1,'jpeg_quality':82,'channels':'RGB','alpha_mode':'NONE'},'geometry_render':False},f,indent=2)
finally:
 if image is not None:bpy.data.images.remove(image)
 if scene is not None:bpy.data.scenes.remove(scene)
 assert bpy.context.scene==original
